title: XP First Post! | A Prequel Game Concept

posts.author: AlienImpulses
posts.body:
UNDERWATER MORTUARY
daylight has drawn to a dreary end
- your limbs pull themselves begrudgingly through the fluorescent hallways of the building you've never known the name of.  this dreamscape is familiar.. too familiar, but each door you open leads to a new hallway, the stench of the molten carpet filling your nose with a nauseating feeling, and you can't help but wonder when the endless nightmare is going to come to a stop.
​
"
Underwater Mortuary
" is a in-the-making surrealist
horror
RPG surrounding the protagonist
MAXINE
, an unemployed 19-year-old plagued by chronic night terrors and terrifying visions of humanoid companions accompanying them throughout their dreams. You, as the player, must navigate these dreamscapes to find key items to escape to the next level. The deeper you enter
MAXINE's
psyche, the more you uncover about these mysterious companions and their duties alongside the victim. Your ultimate goal is to wake
MAXINE
up with various grounding techniques, some of which stretching the limits of what they're capable of in the real world. Wander through endless halls, drown amongst a school of fish, and find no escape to the toy airplanes you shrink into. It's up to you where you stay.
​
hi! call me alien.  i'm the 19-year-old mentally ill individual planning to pour my heart and soul into this game series that i'll be making with rpg maker xp! 'underwater mortuary' is the first game planning to be made in a series of 2-3, the second being a name i've chosen, but will be keeping secret to pique interest if there is any.. it's definitely an early wip, but i'm hopeful to see what people think! (the art was created by me using procreate!)
​
